scope: Uncorrelated engineering screening; no fabrication or EMC sign-off

stackup.notes: R/L solver uses nominal 0.2mm spacing only; spacing range 0.1-0.3mm used in overlap-capacitance estimate. Resolve final stackup before treating R/L as physical values.

passive.status: component values from PCB; effective C, ESR and ESL are assumed ranges, not manufacturer models

ringing.status: bounded commutation fixture; NOT a TPS63070 transistor model

conducted_noise.status: linear differential-mode transfer; no predicted emission amplitude or regulatory detector

thermal.status: four-sheet finite-volume PCB temperature only; package thermal resistance and enclosure not modeled
thermal.notes: Remaining 3.3 V delivered power is assumed dissipated off-board; speaker output is off-board. All package losses enter actual F.Cu solder lands through an isothermal package node with 50um/50W-mK solder. Internal die/package resistance and component-to-air cooling are omitted. Loss split, effective h, duty cycle and copper homogenization need correlation.
